summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with the ordered validation and path resolution from the spec, plus a private _resolve_path helper. Added an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Measured: no line in the three new or changed Python files exceeds 120 columns. Not run: tests, black, and flake8, since execution was prohibited. Nothing committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-object top-level JSON or a non-list key value raises ValueError; items are shallow-copied before resolution.
